tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.description: List the public COTRUGLI contribution opportunities for external agents, models, operators, compute partners, task owners, and verifiers. Optionally filter by a capability keyword.

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one public contribution opportunity by the stable id returned from list_opportunities.

tools.name: get_build_targets
tools.description: List COTRUGLI's publicly named next build targets, including the foreign-agent onboarding door.

tools.name: get_onboarding_status
tools.description: Explain the current public onboarding boundary for an externally built agent and the human commitment rule.

tools.name: get_public_entrypoints
tools.description: Return the public pages an agent or partner can inspect before contacting COTRUGLI.
